blurb: Guests take a 90-minute boat cruise departing daily from Bayside Marketplace in Downtown Miami. The cruise offers views of Miami's skyline, celebrity mansions on Star Island, Palm Island, Hibiscus Island, and Fisher Island, and includes English and Spanish commentary. Cruises run from morning to evening with multiple departure times and feature a comfortable, spacious boat.
extraNote: Full refunds up to 48 hours before departure · Free rescheduling if you miss your tour · No refunds for late arrivals or third-party Mojito Bar purchases · Bayside Marketplace, 401 Biscayne Blvd, Downtown Miami, check in at the window marked for boarding passes
